title: NFTMigrator.migrate() DoS when V1 dispatcher registered after initialization
description: setInitialized() validates that every V1 index has a V2 mapping, but migrate() iterates up to the live v1.nextIndex(). If the V1 owner registers a new dispatcher after initialization, the new V1 index has no V2 mapping (indexMapping[i] == 0). migrate() calls v2.mintFor(0, msg.sender) which reverts because index 0 has no registered dispatcher. This blocks ALL of the user's migrations, not just the unmapped index. Note: this requires the V1 owner to register a new dispatcher (owner-driven action), which the user has indicated is out of scope for attack scenarios, but represents an operational footgun.
impact: Users whose V1 portfolio includes any post-init V1 index have their migration transaction fully revert.
recommendation: In migrate(), skip indexes where indexMapping[i] == 0 instead of calling mintFor(0). Alternatively, freeze V1 dispatcher registration after migrator initialization.
